designVerdict: SELECTED as D14 - lifts the HUSB238A VBUS pin at vSafe5V, where the BSS138 follower falls short.
notes: Anode on the 5 V rail, cathode on the HUSB238A VBUS pin. At a 4.75 V bus the rail is 4.60 V and this part drops 0.37 V max at 1 mA (datasheet p.2), holding the pin at 4.23 V against a 3.15 V minimum - where the follower alone gives 3.05-3.75 V and fails at the low corner.

It conducts only at low bus voltage. Once the bus rises the follower takes the pin to ~18.5 V and this diode is reverse-biased by 13.5 V, inside its 40 V rating - including during a 58.1 V TVS clamp, because the follower's Zener holds the pin at 18.5 V regardless of the drain.
Chosen for low Vf at small current rather than for current capability: the load is 800 uA max. A 1N5819-class power Schottky would drop more at this current, which is the opposite of what is wanted.
